name: Skarner
title: The Crystal Vanguard

passive.name: Threads of Vibration

description.normalized: Skarner's attacks, Shattered Earth, Upheaval, and Impale apply Quaking to targets for 4 seconds (max 3 stacks) . At 3 stacks of Quaking, enemies take 5% - 10% of their max Health as magic damage over its duration. Deals up to 100 - 450 damage against monsters.

passive.rawParsedText:
Skarner's attacks, Shattered Earth, Upheaval, and Impale apply Quaking to targets for 4 seconds (max 3 stacks) .

At 3 stacks of Quaking, enemies take 5% - 10% of their max Health as magic damage over its duration.

Deals up to 100 - 450 damage against monsters.

q.name: Shattered Earth

description.normalized: First Cast: Grabs a boulder, empowering his next 3 attacks to gain 25% / 30% / 35% / 40% Attack Speed and deal 15 / 30 / 45 / 60 (+100% bonus AD +4% bonus Health) physical damage to nearby enemies. The third attack deals an additional 11% of the target's max Health as physical damage and slows by 45% for 1 second. Recast (Upheaval) : Ends this ability and throws the boulder in a target direction. The boulder explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing 15 / 30 / 45 / 60 (+100% bonus AD +4% bonus Health) + 9% of the target's max Health as physical damage to them and nearby enemies and slowing them by 40% for 1 second. Percent Health damage to monsters from the first attack and Upheaval is capped at 200 / 250 / 300 / 350 (+100% bonus AD +4% bonus Health). The first two attacks deal 100% damage to structures. The third attack and Upheaval deal 200% damage to structures.

w.name: Seismic Bastion

description.normalized: Immediately gains a shield that absorbs damage equal to 10% max Health for 2.5 seconds and triggers an earthquake that deals 50 / 70 / 90 / 110 (+80% AP) magic damage and slows nearby enemies by 25% for 1 second.

w.rawParsedText: Immediately gains a shield that absorbs damage equal to 10% max Health for 2.5 seconds and triggers an earthquake that deals 50 / 70 / 90 / 110 (+80% AP) magic damage and slows nearby enemies by 25% for 1 second.

e.name: Ixtal's Impact

description.normalized: First cast: charges in a target direction, ignoring terrain; If he runs into an enemy champion or large monster, he drags them along for the rest of his charge; Colliding into a wall with an enemy in tow deals 60 / 90 / 120 / 150 (+120% bonus AD +6% max Health) physical damage to the enemy and stuns them for 1.5 seconds. Recast: Ends his charge early. Colliding into a wall with an enemy in tow reduces Ixtal's Impact's cooldown by 35%.

r.name: Impale

description.normalized: Lashes his tails forward, dealing 150 / 250 / 350 (+100% AP) magic damage and suppressing the first 3 enemy champions he hits for 1.5 seconds. Champions hit are dragged along by Skarner for the duration of the suppression. If he hits at least one enemy champion: He gains 40% Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds; If Shattered Earth is active, he will cast Upheaval first.
